definition.en: The authorized ability to locate, retrieve, view, download, or otherwise use data under defined technical, legal, ethical, and organizational conditions.
definition.nl: De geautoriseerde mogelijkheid om data te vinden, op te halen, te bekijken, te downloaden of anderszins te gebruiken onder vastgestelde technische, juridische, ethische en organisatorische voorwaarden.

en:
The continued, available for use, ongoing usability of a digital 
resource, retaining all qualities of authenticity, accuracy and 
functionality deemed to be essential for the purposes the digital 
material was created and/or acquired for. Users who have access 
can retrieve, manipulate, copy, and store copies on a wide range 
of hard drives and external devices. (https://codata.org/rdm
terminology/access/)
